note: New spec: a review id after ~~ (a bare ~id is an MRFI) is any unique prefix of an item id, case-insensitive, with or without rvw_, as in agent show/respond/apply. The Deno tool only accepted the full id or the exact short id it displayed per command, so a longer prefix (such as the project-wide short id of critique list or the VS Code panel) was reported missing.
